# kcore_security_group_attachment (Resource)

Attach a security group to a VM or a network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_security_group_attachment" "web_vm" {
  security_group = kcore_security_group.web.name
  target_kind    = "vm"
  target_id      = kcore_vm.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `security_group` (String)
- `target_id` (String)
- `target_kind` (String)

### Optional

- `target_node` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
